text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Aston Machan's insistence, we've
come to the
aquarium.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Splishy, splishy, splash. ♪ Okay, let's go
see the
stars of the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, not quite.
choice_data_list: 海の生き物が好きなのか？
海の生き物が好きなの？

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I do like sea creatures, but today we're
here to
conduct research on adorable
mascots.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to learn the secret to getting
popular
by observing the masters!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's get right to it. We'll start over
there, where
all the people are
gathering.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So everyone was over here to see the
starfish.
And wow, you can even touch
them if you like.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Starfishies have eye-catching looks. But
even
though they're adorable, they're
firm to the
touch. ...Hm. That's an
interesting contrast.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The dolphin show's up next. I'd love to
go and pat
a real sea celebrity on the
head!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh?! How do I describe this... Shiny,
smooth,
but also squishy, with a
plumpness reminiscent of
kelp!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. This has been a real
eye-opener.

text_block_list.name: Dolphin
text_block_list.text: Squeak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan goes on to fully enjoy
everything
the aquarium has to offer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The stars of the sea sure are formidable.
I
glimpsed these plush key chains and
the next
thing I knew, I'd already bought
them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Me too. I'll treasure them as both
research
materials and friends.
choice_data_list: お土産ができてよかったな
お土産ができてよかったね
choice_data_list_en: Glad you were able to get some souvenirs.
Glad you were able to get some souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...On a related note, I've cracked the
secret to
achieving mascot mastery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll show you. Give me five.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea where she's going with
this, but I
do as she says and high-five
her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's the mascot secret. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Looking cute and being
accessible—essentially,
giving the fans
what they want.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Making an impression on people and
then
stealing their hearts. These are the
essential
elements of being a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And that concludes today's report.
Aston
Machan signing off.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And that concludes today's report.
Aston
Machan signing off.
choice_data_list_en: Can we put this to good use?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It sure is. Now I just need a way to put it
to good
use. Maybe we could do a
meet-and-greet?
choice_data_list_en: Can we put this to good use?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We can sell Machan merch as well, and
double
the impact. What do you think?
Good, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sight of her grinning as she
formulates her
plan is enough to warm
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think I can. For instance... we
could put
together something totally out
there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Like... what if we released some Machan
merch
with hands the exact same size as
my real hands?
And if we made them
warm, they'd feel even more
real.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now that I think about it, that's
actually a
bit creepy. Scrap that idea. I
do think we're on
the right track,
though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's mascot passion is
second to
none. Listening to her makes
me want to do
everything in my power
to help.
